Dietary Supplement

Notice: Use this product as a food supplement only. Do not use for weight reduction.

Suggested usage: simply add one packet to 6-8 fl oz of water or juice, mix thoroughly. Clumping may occur in cold water. Mix with a bit of warm water and add remaining water or juice after product has dissolved.
Contains: fish (one or more of the following: cod, pollock, haddock & hake)

A healthy look starts from within...
Pomegranate flavored Solumeve hydrolyzed marine collagen peptides is the perfect addition to your daily routine.
Fruity and delicious pomegranate collagen powder mix - just add water.

These convenient, on-the-go packets contain 5g of hydrolyzed marine collagen peptides to help support healthy-looking skin, hair & strong nails. Hyaluronic acid maintains skin hydration, while vitamin C helps with collagen synthesis and provides antioxidant support.
